learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn how little seeds become huge trees and how baby animals grow up to look like their parents!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A tiny seed hides a baby plant inside! When we give a seed soil, water, and sunlight, it wakes up and starts growing. This magical process is called germination.

All living things grow and change. A tiny caterpillar turns into a beautiful butterfly, and a little chick hatches from an egg to become a hen. Babies (offspring) grow up to look just like their parents!

Just like plants and animals, you are growing every day! Your clothes and shoes get tighter because your bones and muscles are getting longer and stronger. Eating healthy food helps you grow big and strong.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Little Gardener!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a small paper cup, put some damp cotton or soil inside, and plant a few mustard or gram seeds. Check on them every day to watch your little seedlings sprout!

quick_recap: ⭐ Seeds need water, soil, and sunlight to grow into a plant.
⭐ The journey of growing from a baby to an adult is called a life cycle.
⭐ Healthy food and play help human babies grow into strong adults.
